class.name: NetwLifecycleRequest
class.brief_description: A spawn, despawn or move by a controlling client, waiting for the server to accept it.
class.description: The server passes one to [member NetwEntity.lifecycle_handler] for each change the [member NetwEntity.controller] of a [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] entity makes, and can call [method NetwRequest.deny] before other peers see it. [codeblock] func judge_change(request: NetwLifecycleRequest) -> void: if request.kind == NetwLifecycleRequest.KIND_DESPAWN and not may_remove(request.peer_id): request.deny("only the builder removes it") [/codeblock] Once denied, the request stays denied. The peer that made the change receives [signal NetwEntity.lifecycle_refused] with the [member NetwRequest.code] and the [member NetwRequest.reason].

members.member: The parent the entity is placed under, or [code]null[/code] for [constant KIND_DESPAWN]. On a spawn [member entity] has not entered the tree yet, so read the world from here.
The entity the change is about. On a spawn it is the server's copy, holding the values the controller sent.

constants.constant: The controller spawned the entity with [method Netw.spawn].
The controller despawned the entity with [method Netw.despawn] or [method NetwEntity.despawn].
The controller moved the entity with [method Netw.reparent] or [method Node.reparent].
